# Controlled owning workflow

Use this closure for the two historical conversation-continuity journeys. The
manifest retains the eda5c08a9fbcc4a308537b17f0b9547108fbc748 origin and each
original path, source locator and exact hash. Fourteen differing model-aware
sources live here; 71 common sources are copied from the checkout. A real clean
signed owner commit supplies preparation identity. No historical worktree or Git
object is needed in CI. Ordinary refusal, permission, uncertainty and concurrent
journeys select current-shaped owners instead.

The retained Phase and Ticket definitions preserve the original Haiku selection
and relative control -> text-storage -> native-node dependency. The old extractor
naturally refuses the narrated original reply. The recovery overlay then uses the
repaired parser while ordinary Ticket components come from that prepared owner.
Ticket.SelectModel is present for dormant syntax preflight; ordinary continuation
does not invoke it.

The public host keeps one controller and ACP session store across independent
original, recovery, feedback and correction roots. Each invocation retains its
own source, journal and post-cleanup settlement. The concurrent public recovery
journey holds cleanup and verifies both roots' evidence as well as exclusive
publication. Two real filesystem rename failures cover precommit refusal and
unknown acknowledgment. No Ticket publication component is stubbed.

Each runtime suite launches reconcile-response.md once through its own public CLI
entry. git-boundary.ts and boundary/Git/Changes.ts connect that entry to the real
signed repositories; no-dispatch.ts rejects reconciliation prompts and role
execution. Other recovery cases enter Ticket.ReconcileResponse through real
public document roots. Diagnosis uses its own lightweight repository and ACP
route, with no recovery Ticket.

The immediate JoinedResponseRecovery.test.md owns discovery. Recovery.RunSuite
joins the nested suite once under the current runtime, using the repository's
existing one-file command conventions. Bun needs an explicit ./ path for this
non-test filename and the existing 300000ms repository test cap; no deadline is
changed. Deno vectors retain manual dependency layout, cached inputs and a frozen
lock.

```bash
deno task test examples/adversarial-implementation/tests/JoinedResponseRecovery.test.md
pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.node.json --test --test-concurrency=1 examples/adversarial-implementation/tests/runtime/joined-response-recovery-suite.ts
bun test --timeout=300000 ./examples/adversarial-implementation/tests/runtime/joined-response-recovery-suite.ts
```

The nine immutable captures under ../historical-submit are a separate narrow
internal compatibility exception. Mapped-only read storage supplies their exact
original Submit bytes to production JoinedProof. Original acceptance and a change
elsewhere in the whole native log exercise authentic framing and whole-log
binding. This does not manufacture a historical Ticket, replace public recovery
journeys or invoke historical #1400. All removed investigation cases remain in
the assignment's outside-source archive.
